'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Capture of Chernobyl|Battle of Chernobyl]]
****[[Energoatom]] confirms that the [[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] who occupied the former [[Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant|nuclear power plant]] in [[Chernobyl]] have left the [[Chernobyl Exclusion Zone]]. [https://www.ukrinform.net/rubric-ato/3444941-russian-invaders-leaving-chornobyl-npp-energoatom.html (Ukrinform)]
****The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] confirms that Russian forces have handed over control of the former [[nuclear power plant]] back to [[Ukraine]]. Russian troops also withdraw from the city of [[Slavutych]], returning to [[Belarus]]. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/03/31/russians-hand-control-of-chernobyl-nuclear-plant-back-to-ukraine-iaea-says.html (CNBC)]
***[[Siege of Mariupol]]
****[[Deputy Prime Minister of Ukraine|Ukrainian Deputy Prime Minister]] [[Iryna Vereshchuk]] says that [[Ukraine]] has sent buses to [[Mariupol]] in an effort to evacuate citizens from the city. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-60938429 (BBC News)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]], [[2022 Bnei Brak shootings]]
**Two people are killed and 14 more injured as the [[Israeli Defense Forces]] raid the city of [[Jenin]] in the [[West Bank]] in order to capture a suspect linked to Tuesday's shooting in Bnei Brak. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-kills-at-least-2-palestinians-in-jenin-gunbattle-israeli-injured-in-stabbing/ (''Times of Israel'')] [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/three-palestinians-wounded-in-gunfire-exchange-with-israeli-army-in-jenin-1.10710447 (''Haaretz'')]
**A [[Palestinian political violence|Palestinian militant]] uses a [[screwdriver]] to stab and seriously injure an [[Israelis|Israeli]] civilian on a bus in [[Neve Daniel]], before being shot dead by another passenger. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israeli-moderately-wounded-after-stabbing-attack-on-west-bank-bus-1.10710569 (''Haaretz'')]
**[[Rock throwing]] causes a bus to crash into a car in [[Halhul]], [[West Bank]], injuring two people. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/rock-attack-causes-car-crash-in-west-bank-wounding-2/ (''Times of Israel'')]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Expo 2020]]
**The [[World's fair#World Expos|world expo]] in [[Dubai]], [[United Arab Emirates]], which was delayed to October 1, 2021, closes after six months. [https://apnews.com/article/covid-entertainment-business-health-middle-east-bfb77f420f3f6429b37bdebf0f6bc024 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic consequences of the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Economic impact of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
***[[Australia]] revokes the [[most favoured nation]] status for [[Russia]] and [[Belarus]], and will impose 35% [[tariff]]s on produce coming from these countries beginning on April 25. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2022/mar/31/australia-news-live-updates-rain-weather-floods-nsw-qld-scott-morrison-election-budget-zelenskiy-covid-coronavirus (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2021–2022 global energy crisis]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] orders the release of up to one million barrels of [[Petroleum|crude oil]] per day from the [[Strategic Petroleum Reserve (United States)|Strategic Petroleum Reserve]] for the next six months in an attempt to contain [[inflation]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/business/2022/mar/31/us-release-oil-strategic-reserve-gas-price (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Wildfires in 2022]]
**Evacuations and school closures are issued in [[Sevier County, Tennessee|Sevier County]], [[Tennessee]], [[United States]], after a wildfire, known as the Hatcher Mountain Road/Indigo Lane Fire, breaks out near the [[Great Smoky Mountains National Park]] and grows to 1,000 acres. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/03/31/weather/tennessee-brush-fire-evacuations/index.html (CNN)]
*A chartered helicopter travelling to [[Ulupna Island]], [[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]], [[Australia]], crashes into [[Mount Disappointment (Australia)|Mount Disappointment]], killing all five people onboard. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2022-03-31/helicopter-crash-mount-disappointment-north-of-melbourne/100954600 (ABC News Australia)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
***[[Pakistan]] disbands ll the National Command and Operations Center (NCOC), which was overseeing the [[COVID-19]] response in the country, as the infection’s numbers were at the lowest since the start of the outbreak early in 2020. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/pakistan-disbands-covid-19-response-body-infections-lowest-2022-03-31/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Georgia–Russia relations]]
**[[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] says plans by the breakaway state of [[South Ossetia]], which is internationally recognized as occupied Georgian territory, to hold a referendum on becoming a part of [[Russia]] are "unacceptable". [https://www.reuters.com/world/breakaway-georgian-region-abkhazia-says-it-has-no-plans-join-russia-2022-03-31/ (Reuters)]
*[[Federated States of Micronesia|Micronesia]]n president [[David Panuelo]] urges [[Solomon Islands]] to not sign a security pact with [[China]], citing "grave security concerns" and arguing that the [[Pacific islands]] would be "the epicenter of major confrontation" between major powers. [https://www.reuters.com/world/micronesia-urges-solomons-islands-not-sign-china-security-pact-2022-03-31/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Russia investigation origins counter-narrative]]
**The U.S. [[Federal Election Commission]] fines the [[Democratic National Committee]] (DNC) and [[Hillary Clinton]]'s [[Hillary Clinton 2016 presidential campaign|2016 campaign]] for violating rules by funding the [[Steele dossier]], a dossier which made accusations of collusion between the Trump campaign and Russia. Both the DNC and Clinton's campaign have agreed not to contest the fines and to pay civil penalties of [[US$]]105,000 and US$8,000 respectively. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2022/03/30/fec-dnc-clinton-campaign/ (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.businessinsider.com/fec-fines-clinton-campaign-dnc-over-spending-trump-russia-dossier-2022-3 (''Business Insider'')]
*[[Sri Lankan economic crisis (2019–present)|Sri Lankan economic crisis]]
**[[Sri Lanka Police]] impose an indefinite [[curfew]] in the city of [[Colombo]] after protesters attempted to storm president [[Gotabaya Rajapaksa]]'s private residence amid anger over worsening economic conditions and [[power outage]]s in the country. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/3/31/tear-gas-as-sri-lanka-protesters-try-to-storm-presidents-house (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*The acting [[Australian Information Commissioner]] orders the [[Prime Minister's Office (Australia)|Prime Minister's Office]] (PMO) to comply with a request by ''[[The Guardian]]'' under the ''[[Freedom of Information Act 1982]]'', which the PMO had previously rejected, and search the [[mobile phone]] of [[Prime Minister of Australia|Prime Minister]] [[Scott Morrison]] for correspondence with Morrison's friend and [[QAnon]] conspiracy theorist Tim Stewart. The [[Australian Broadcasting Corporation]] has alleged that Stewart influenced Morrison's use of the term "[[Satanic panic|ritual abuse]]" in a speech to survivors of [[child sexual abuse]] in 2019. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/mar/31/scott-morrison-australian-pm-prime-minister-must-reveal-any-text-messages-from-qanon-friend-tim-stewart-burnedspy34-information-watchdog-orders (''The Guardian'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Censorship of Wikipedia]], [[Media freedom in Russia]]
**Russian media censorship agency [[Roskomnadzor]] threatens to fine [[Wikipedia]] up to 4 million rubles (about US$49,000) if it does not delete information that contradicts the Kremlin's official narrative on the [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/dereksaul/2022/03/31/russia-demands-wikipedia-take-down-information-about-ukraine-war/?sh=4e48a7b966f2 (''Forbes'')]
* Scientists sequence the complete [[human genome]] for the first time, more than three decades after the [[Human Genome Project]] was first commenced. [https://www.cnn.com/2022/03/31/health/first-complete-human-genome-sequence/index.html (CNN)]
